### Config Files > Environment Variable Example

Source: https://github.com/brianpugh/cyclopts/blob/main/docs/source/config_file.rst

The `Env` configuration class automatically derives and reads environment variables. It constructs environment variable names by combining a provided prefix, the command path, and the parameter's CLI name (with hyphens replaced by underscores).

--------------------------------

### API > Parameter Configuration > env_var

Source: https://github.com/brianpugh/cyclopts/blob/main/docs/source/api.rst

The 'env_var' attribute allows fallback to environment variables if a CLI value is not provided. If multiple variables are listed, the first one with a set value is used. If no environment variable is set, it falls back to the function signature default.

--------------------------------

### API > Parameter Configuration > show_env_var

Source: https://github.com/brianpugh/cyclopts/blob/main/docs/source/api.rst

The 'show_env_var' attribute, when True, displays the environment variable name on the help page if an 'env_var' is set.

--------------------------------

### API > Parameter Configuration > env_var_split

Source: https://github.com/brianpugh/cyclopts/blob/main/docs/source/api.rst

The 'env_var_split' attribute specifies a function to split the value read from an environment variable. This function must accept the parameter type hint and the environment value string, and return a list of strings.

--------------------------------

### Parameters > Help

Source: https://github.com/brianpugh/cyclopts/blob/main/docs/source/parameters.rst

While docstrings are the recommended way to provide help text for parameters, you can explicitly set a help string using the `help` attribute within `Parameter`. This explicit setting will override any help text provided in the docstring.
